Very soluble in water; soluble in alcohol. Protect from light. Profile Proxyphylline is a derivative of theophylline (p.1140) which is used as a bronchodilator and for its cardiovascular properties. Proxyphylline is readily absorbed from the gastrointestinal tract and it is not converted to theophylline in the body.
